args.action: The five tiny separate stone chips kick outward briefly, tumble, fall down under gravity, then shrink and disappear into transparency. Single sparse debris burst. Never join together or form a surface. No ground, no crater, no circular shape, no shadow. Keep fragments tiny with empty background.

A quick sideways shear of teal liquid toward the left, stretch into separated aqua droplets, droplets follow downward arcs, shrink and dissipate completely. Strong asymmetric diagonal hit with fast start, unlike a centered splash. Single impact, no loop, no character or scenery, maintain transparent border.

The bright contact spark deflects into a narrow fan of short amber metal shards shooting rightward, then fragments curve down, dim and disappear. Distinct asymmetrical armor glancing-hit burst, no repeating star pulsation. Single impact, empty transparent finish, no object or background.
